# Original loader fixture provenance

`mini-basis.glb` is an original synthetic wedge hull and 8×8 blue/ochre checker
texture generated by `scripts/generate-ship-fixture.mjs` for Weather Gage. No
archive image, marketplace model, or external artwork was copied or traced.
This fixture is original project test data, not historically accurate ship art
or a registered hero model. No third-party artwork or model license is assumed
or introduced by this fixture.

- Geometry: 210×28 metre source hull, 12 triangles; normalization yields 9 world units long.
- Encoding: Khronos KTX-Software **4.4.2**, ETC1S / BasisLZ KTX2, embedded via `KHR_texture_basisu`.
- Encoder source/release: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/KTX-Software/releases/tag/v4.4.2
- Temporary Darwin arm64 package SHA-256: `500bd8f9d63358c3f3a0d83b724c8574436a72c37dc0e4bad90ec1ca38032c3c`.
- Fixture SHA-256: `2821c8f0b31f4f961cd6d855518473bb8fd273e176fe232e7d80ee9a7bc777db`.
- Fixture size: **2484 bytes**. Encoder binaries are not redistributed with the repository.
